summary: Iteration 13: Tested Subscription Plans system (SuperAdmin CRUD, plan assignment, sidebar filtering by modules, limit enforcement). 13/13 backend tests PASSED + 1 skipped (limit not at edge). Frontend: SuperAdmin /admin/planes renders 3 default plan cards correctly, /admin/opticas shows plan badges + 'Cerca del limite' warnings, sidebar filtering works perfectly for both Free (hides Inventario/Ventas/Proveedores/Finanzas) and Enterprise (shows all modules). Patient/Branch limit enforcement works (POST /api/branches returns 403 with proper message when at limit). Login + /auth/me return plan_name, plan_modules, max_patients, patients_count, *_warning, *_limit_reached fields correctly. Only gap: DashboardPage.js does not implement a plan-limit warning card despite the request listing it.

minor.issue: ObjectId(plan_id) called without try/except. Malformed plan_id will produce 500 instead of 400/422. Same applies to /api/plans/assign/{company_id}?plan_id=... and /api/plans/usage/{company_id}.

integration_issues.issue: Demo company is on Free plan with 1/1 branches (at limit, branches_limit_reached=true) but the dashboard does not display any plan-limit warning card. /api/auth/me returns the warning flags correctly; UI does not consume them on /dashboard. Review request lists 'Frontend /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js: Plan limit warning card' which appears unimplemented (no references to plan/limit/warning in DashboardPage.js).

frontend: SuperAdmin login -> /admin/planes shows 3 plan cards (Free Q0, Basic Q299, Enterprise Q799) with correct limits and module chips highlighted
/admin/opticas: plan badges (Free, Enterprise) and 'Cerca del limite' warning badge visible on company cards
Demo admin (Free plan) sidebar HIDES Inventario, Ventas, Proveedores, Finanzas
Demo admin sidebar SHOWS Dashboard, Pacientes, Consultas, Agenda, Recetas, Cotizaciones, Sucursales, Usuarios, Reportes
Altavista admin (Enterprise plan) sidebar SHOWS all modules including Inventario, Ventas, Proveedores, Finanzas
Login as analuhs@gmail.com / Alta2026$ works (Altavista admin)

action_items: [FEATURE GAP - MEDIUM] Implement plan-limit warning card in /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js. /api/auth/me already returns patients_warning/branches_warning/patients_limit_reached/branches_limit_reached/plan_name/patients_count/max_patients - just need a card consuming these.
[MINOR] Wrap ObjectId() conversions in /app/backend/routes/plans.py (update/delete/assign/usage) in try/except to return 400 on invalid IDs instead of 500.
[INFO] Free plan modules array is empty as expected; sidebar filter logic in MainLayout.js (line 35) correctly hides module-gated items based on user.plan_modules.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/plans.py: assign_plan stores plan_id as ObjectId in companies but list_plans returns _id as string. Consistent serialization needed - companies.py join should handle both shapes.
auth.py login() and get_me() duplicate ~20 lines of plan-info attachment logic. Extract to a helper async def attach_plan_info(user_dict, company_id) for DRY.
DashboardPage.js missing plan-limit warning UI even though backend exposes all required flags - feature listed in review_request but not implemented.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 passed, 1 skipped because demo not at patient limit)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all sidebar filtering, plan management, badges working; plan-limit warning card on dashboard not implemented)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Plan_<timestamp> via POST /api/plans -> DELETE /api/plans/{id}. No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plans system is fully functional. Backend routes at /api/plans (CRUD), /api/plans/assign/{company_id}?plan_id=, /api/plans/usage/{company_id}. Auth endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/me) attach plan_name, plan_modules (array of 'inventario'|'ventas'|'proveedores'|'finanzas'), max_patients, max_branches, patients_count, branches_count, *_warning (>=80%), *_limit_reached. Default plans seeded: Free (Q0, 1 branch, 50 patients, []), Basic (Q299, 3 branches, 500 patients, [inventario,ventas]), Enterprise (Q799, 0=unlimited branches, 0=unlimited patients, all 4 modules). Sidebar filter is in MainLayout.js using user.plan_modules. Demo company is on Free plan and at branch limit (1/1) - good for testing limit warnings. Altavista (analuhs@gmail.com) is on Enterprise plan. Limit enforcement happens in /api/patients POST and /api/branches POST returning 403 with detail message in Spanish.
rca_of_minor_issue: DashboardPage.js does not import or render plan_warning data. To fix, read user from AuthContext (already populated with plan_name, *_warning, *_limit_reached, *_count, max_*) and render a yellow/red warning card when patients_warning || branches_warning is true.
